name: postolio-infrastructure
description: AWS CDK infrastructure for Postolio application

scripts.deploy:scheduler:dev: npm run prepare:layers && cdk deploy ContentScheduler-dev -c environment=dev --app 'npx ts-node --prefer-ts-exts bin/scheduler-app.ts' --require-approval never
scripts.deploy:scheduler:staging: npm run prepare:layers && cdk deploy ContentScheduler-staging -c environment=staging --app 'npx ts-node --prefer-ts-exts bin/scheduler-app.ts' --require-approval never
scripts.deploy:scheduler:prod: npm run prepare:layers && cdk deploy ContentScheduler-prod -c environment=prod --app 'npx ts-node --prefer-ts-exts bin/scheduler-app.ts' --require-approval broadening
scripts.synth:scheduler: npm run prepare:layers && cdk synth ContentScheduler-* -c environment=dev --app 'npx ts-node --prefer-ts-exts bin/scheduler-app.ts'
scripts.diff:scheduler: npm run prepare:layers && cdk diff ContentScheduler-dev -c environment=dev --app 'npx ts-node --prefer-ts-exts bin/scheduler-app.ts'
